Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of GS.
Our gross margin expanded by 131 basis points to 41.9%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.

Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 317 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Revenue guidance of $37.6 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.

Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
